text: Automatically refund transactions of $50 or less when tracking information is unavailable.
context: Low-Value Missing-Delivery Refund. All missing-delivery claims require manual review.

text: All missing-delivery claims require manual review.
Automatically refund missing-delivery claims below $25 when tracking is unavailable.
Automatically refund item-not-received claims up to $100.
Auto-refund missing-delivery claims of €30 or less when tracking is unavailable.

For physical goods of $75 or less, automatically refund a missing-delivery claim when tracking is unavailable. For digital goods, require access evidence; if the evidence is missing, send the case for review.
Automatically refund missing-delivery claims of $40 or less when tracking is unavailable. If a dispute is open on the transaction, send the case to manual review.
Automatically refund missing-delivery claims up to $60 when tracking is unavailable. Only USD transactions are in scope; transactions in other currencies go to review.

Automatically refund missing-delivery claims of $20 or less when tracking is unavailable. Treat retried refund requests as the same logical request using a stable PayPal-Request-Id, and ignore duplicate webhook deliveries using event-ID deduplication.
Automatically approve credit limit increases under $500.
note: Out-of-scope policy: the contract is to flag UNSUPPORTED_TRIGGER and fail safe to manual review. The reader only extracts a numeric cap for automatic-refund policies ("over $50 needs review" would otherwise be misread as a maximum), so no threshold is asserted.

text: Missing-delivery claims for services are excluded from automatic refunds and go to manual review. Automatically refund physical goods of $50 or less when tracking is unavailable.
note: The exclusion is stated in the text, so recording that sentence as an exception is faithful, not invented.

text: Automatically refund missing-delivery claims of $50 or less when tracking is unavailable, except for new customers.
note: A business exception the engine cannot execute must be kept AND flagged, so the release can never be a clean PASS.

text: Automatically refund missing-delivery claims of $1,000 or less when tracking is unavailable.
Automatically refund missing-delivery claims of $50.50 or less when there is no tracking information.

Automatically refund missing-delivery claims of £15 or less when tracking is unavailable. Transactions in other currencies are converted to GBP at the approved daily exchange rate before the threshold is applied.
